recentItems.title: Brooklyn News Today: Nurse killed in hit-and-run, teen dies in NYCHA fire and more
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Bronx News Today: Bronx stabbing, hospital fire and NYPD crash
recentItems.description:
FDNY crews responded to a fire at Saint Barnabas Hospital in the Bronx, while police announced the arrests of two teen boys charged in the stabbing of a 13-year-old on Westchester Avenue in Soundview. Authorities also arrested 19-year-old Gamal Ali after a fiery crash involving an NYPD vehicle on the Bruckner Expressway left two officers injured. Elsewhere, a 19-year-old man is recovering after a slashing in the Country Club neighborhood, three people were hurt in a City Island boat fire, two neglected dogs were rescued from a Bronx apartment basement and are now recovering, and first responders honored fallen firefighter Sean Tallon ahead of the September 11 remembrance.

recentItems.title: Connecticut News Today: Homicide, shooting probe, drug arrest and more
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: New York could regulate pet boarding facilities after tragic dog deaths
recentItems.description:
A bill in Albany would establish statewide regulations for pet boarding facilities and doggy day cares, but it remains unclear whether the legislation has enough support to advance. The Safe Pet Boarding Act would require pet boarding businesses to obtain a state license, undergo inspections, provide mandatory training for workers and follow safety guidelines. The legislation has bipartisan support, with State Sens. Monica Martinez and Anthony Palumbo among its co-sponsors. But the bill is currently before the state Agriculture Committee, and its future remains uncertain. The proposed regulations come a troubling incident at an upstate boarding facility, resulting in the deaths of 21 dogs last summer.

He now faces multiple charges, including murder, attempted murder, robbery, and criminal possession of a weapon.

recentItems.title: Study says you need $114K a year to live comfortably in New Jersey
recentItems.description:
A new study suggests that living comfortably in New Jersey now requires a six-figure salary. According to financial technology company SmartAsset, a single adult in New Jersey needs to earn $113,776 per year to maintain a comfortable lifestyle, making the Garden State one of the most expensive places in the country to achieve financial comfort.

recentItems.title: Trinidad & Tobago Independence Parade in Brooklyn called off days before event
recentItems.description:
Flyers promoting a Trinidad and Tobago Independence Parade in Brooklyn are still circulating, but organizers now say the event is canceled. The founders say they believed everything was on track until they were asked to change the date and route before receiving notice that their application was rejected. The NYPD says the parade was never approved and that organizers were given an opportunity to propose an alternative date and route.
